overview_description.description: Multifactor provides secure identity management with authentication, authorization, and auditing using strong cryptography. It provides a secure account-management and access-sharing platform designed for both humans and AI agents. The service functions as a “vault” for passwords, passkeys, 2FA codes, and other authentication materials, enabling users to store all their login credentials in one secure place.

about_short_description.short_description: Multifactor provides secure identity management with authentication, authorization, and auditing using strong cryptography.

product.name: Multifactor Account Manager
product.description: A secure account-management platform for storing passwords, passkeys, 2FA codes, and other credentials, while enabling granular account sharing without exposing passwords.

product.name: Multi AI Assistant
product.description: An AI assistant that uses accounts stored in Multifactor to perform approved tasks through isolated cloud browsers without exposing raw credentials to the AI or third parties.

identifier.value: Multifactor Enterprise Identity and Access Management

product.name: Multifactor Enterprise Identity and Access Management
product.description: An enterprise identity security platform for cryptographically enforced authentication, authorization, and auditing, with role-based access control, SSO integrations, compliance features, and managed support.

product.name: Multifactor Entropy Stack
product.description: An open-source cryptographic stack for deriving keys, hashing authentication policies, and generating passwords from flexible combinations of authentication factors.

product.name: MFKDF2
product.description: A multi-factor key derivation function that derives cryptographic keys from user-defined combinations and threshold policies involving multiple authentication factors.

product.name: MFCHF2
product.description: A multi-factor credential hashing function that represents an entire authentication policy in a single cryptographic hash instead of storing separate hashes and factor secrets.
